# MALDI-MSI data preparation 

## Software requirments 

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(foreach)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(scater)
library(BiocParallel)
library(Cardinal)
```


## 1. Read in data 

```{r}
mse_1 <- readMSIData("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/raw/ztma_20_rcc_no_normalized_complete_spectrum.imzML", as = "MSImagingExperiment")
mse_2 <- readMSIData("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/raw/ztma_224_rcc_no_normalized_complete_spectrum.imzML", as = "MSImagingExperiment")

mse_1
mse_2
```


```{r}
# Spectra data
spectraData(mse_1)
spectra(mse_1, "intensity")

# Pixel data
pixelData(mse_1)
pixelData(mse_2)
coord(mse_1)[,"z"] <- as.numeric(coord(mse_1)[,"z"])
coord(mse_2)[,"z"] <- as.numeric(coord(mse_2)[,"z"])

# Runnames
runNames(mse_1)

# Features
featureData(mse_1)
```

```{r}
# Plot 
## Different spectra numbers
plot(mse_1, i=c(10, 100))
plot(mse_1, i=c(10, 100), xlim=c(300, 400), ylim=c(0,10000000),
    superpose=TRUE)

# By coordinates
plot(mse_1, coord=list(x = 1, y = 11, z = 1))
```


## 2. Preprocessing 

### Normalization, Smoothing, Peak picking

```{r}
# Processing
## Includes Normalization, Smoothing and Peak Picking
mse_1_proc_SNR25 <- mse_1 |> 
  normalize(method="rms") |> 
  smooth() |> 
  peakPick(method = "filter", SNR = 2)

mse_1_proc_SNR30 <- mse_1 |> 
  normalize(method="rms") |>
  smooth() |>
  peakPick(method = "filter", SNR = 3)

mse_1_proc_SNR15 <- mse_1 |> 
  normalize(method="rms") |>
  smooth() |>
  peakPick(method = "filter", SNR = 1.5)

# Full spectra
plot(mse_1, i=c(10, 100, 10000, 501), ylim=c(0,4e+06))

# Broad regions
plot(mse_1, i=c(10, 100, 10000, 501), xlim = c(200, 400), ylim=c(0,4e+06))
plot(mse_1_proc_SNR25, i=c(10, 100, 10000, 501), xlim = c(200, 400), ylim=c(0,1e+07), legend = FALSE)
plot(mse_1_proc_SNR30, i=c(10, 100, 10000, 501), xlim = c(200, 400), ylim=c(0,1e+07))

plot(mse_1, i=c(10, 100, 10000, 501), xlim = c(100, 200), ylim=c(0,4e+06))
plot(mse_1_proc_SNR25, i=c(10, 100, 10000, 501), xlim = c(100, 200), ylim=c(0,1e+07), legend = FALSE)
plot(mse_1_proc_SNR30, i=c(10, 100, 10000, 501), xlim = c(100, 200), ylim=c(0,1e+07))


# Detailed regions
plot(mse_1, i=c(10, 100, 10000, 501), xlim = c(380, 400), ylim=c(0,4e+06))
plot(mse_1_proc_SNR25, i=c(10, 100, 10000, 501), xlim = c(380, 400), ylim=c(0,1e+07), legend = FALSE)
plot(mse_1_proc_SNR30, i=c(10, 100, 10000, 501), xlim = c(380, 400), ylim=c(0,1e+07))

plot(mse_1, i=c(10, 100, 10000, 501), xlim = c(200, 220), ylim = c(0,4e+06))
plot(mse_1_proc_SNR25, i=c(10, 100, 10000, 501), xlim = c(200, 220), ylim=c(0,1e+07))
plot(mse_1_proc_SNR30, i=c(10, 100, 10000, 501), xlim = c(200, 220), ylim=c(0,1e+07))
```

### Peak align 

```{r}
# Run peak alignment - Calls process() - Takes long?
## TMA20
mse_1_proc_SNR25_aligned <- peakAlign(mse_1_proc_SNR25)
saveRDS(mse_1_proc_SNR25_aligned, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TM20_aligned_SNR25.rds")

mse_1_proc_SNR30_aligned <- peakAlign(mse_1_proc_SNR30)
saveRDS(mse_1_proc_SNR30_aligned, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TM20_aligned_SNR30.rds")

mse_1_proc_SNR15 <- peakAlign(mse_1_proc_SNR15)
saveRDS(mse_1_proc_SNR30_aligned, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TM20_aligned_SNR15.rds")

## TMA224
mse_2_proc_SNR25_aligned <- peakAlign(mse_2_proc_SNR25)
saveRDS(mse_2_proc_SNR25_aligned, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TM224_aligned_SNR25.rds")

mse_2_proc_SNR30_aligned <- peakAlign(mse_2_proc_SNR30)
saveRDS(mse_2_proc_SNR30_aligned, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TM224_aligned_SNR30.rds")

mse_2_proc_SNR15 <- peakAlign(mse_2_proc_SNR15)
saveRDS(mse_2_proc_SNR30_aligned, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TM224_aligned_SNR15.rds")
```


```{r}
fData(mse_1_proc_SNR30_aligned)
fData(mse_1_proc_SNR25_aligned)
```

# Peak filtering

```{r}
mse_1_proc_SNR30_filtered <- subsetFeatures(mse_1_proc_SNR30_aligned, freq > 0.01)
fData(mse_1_proc_SNR30_filtered)

mse_1_proc_SNR25_filtered <- subsetFeatures(mse_1_proc_SNR25_aligned, freq > 0.01)
fData(mse_1_proc_SNR25_filtered)


```




CONTINUE HERE

```{r}
# Mean feature intensities
mean_1 <- summarizeFeatures(mse_1_peaks, stat="mean")

mean_2 <- summarizeFeatures(mse_2_norm, FUN="mean")


mean_df <- rbind(fData(mean_1) %>% as.data.frame %>% mutate(data = "TMA20"), fData(mean_2) %>% as.data.frame %>% mutate(data = "TMA224"))

ggplot(mean_df, aes(mz, mean, color = data))+
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5)+
  theme_classic()

ggplot(mean_df %>% filter(mz < 500 & mz > 400), aes(mz, mean, color = data))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()

ggplot(mean_df %>% filter(mz < 750 & mz > 740), aes(mz, mean, color = data))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()

ggplot(mean_df %>% filter(mz < 550 & mz > 540), aes(mz, mean, color = data))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()
```


```{r}
# check difference of mass bins 
mean_df_diff <- mean_df %>% group_by(data) %>% arrange(mz) %>% mutate(diff = c(NA,diff(mz)))

ggplot(mean_df_diff, aes(data, diff, color = data))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_classic()

ggplot(mean_df_diff, aes(mz, diff, color = data))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()
```
